name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
February 14, 2012
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Reverend Marti Harvey of the Body, Mind & Soul Spiritual Center
Recommended Action:
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION *3
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proposed New Hospital Concept - Larry Anderson, Tri-City Hospital Foundation
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ended December 31, 2011 (CC)
C4.
Vacation of Public Services Easements (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving and authorizing the Summary Vacation for the right to extend drainage structures at 1005 and 1007 Maryland Drive.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving and authorizing the Summary Vacation for the sewer easements within Map 10150.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving and authorizing the Summary Vacation of an easement for sewer lines and appurtenances over the property at 745 Avenida De Benito Juarez.
C5.
Amended Enforceable Obligation Payment Schedule, Redevelopment Obligation Retirement Fund, and Successor Agency Cooperation Agreement (CC/SA)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , acknowledging the existence and operation of the Successor Agency to the Vista Redevelopment Agency.
2.
Adopt Successor Agency Board Resolution No. 2012- , regarding Certain Successor Agency Operations.
3.
Adopt Successor Agency Board Resolution No. 2012- , adopting an Enforceable Obligation Payment Schedule Pursuant to Health and Safety Code Section 34177 and Taking Certain Actions in Connection Therewith.
4.
Adopt Successor Agency Board Resolution No. 2012- , creating a Redevelopment Obligation Retirement Fund Pursuant to Payment Schedule Pursuant to Health and Safety Code Section 34170.5 and Taking Certain Actions in Connection Therewith.
5.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving a Cooperation Agreement with the Successor Agency to the Vista Redevelopment Agency.
6.
Adopt Successor Agency Board Resolution No. 2012- , approving a Cooperation Agreement with the City of Vista.
C6.
Janitorial Services Agreement (CC)
C7.
Playa Azul Mexican Restaurant Application for Cabaret License (CC)
C8.
Assembly Bill 936 (CC/SA)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , pursuant to Assembly Bill 936 concerning forgiveness of loans, advances or other indebtedness.
2.
Adopt Successor Agency Board of Directors Resolution No. 2012- , in connection with Assembly Bill 936 concerning forgiveness of loans, advances or other indebtedness.
C9.
SR78 Sycamore Off-Ramp Amendment (CC)
C10.
Appointment of Alternate to SANDAG Board of Directors (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , appointing Councilmember Cowles first alternate to the Board of Directors of the San Diego Association of Governments.
2.
Confirm the Mayor's appointment of Councilmember Cowles as alternate representative to the SANDAG Public Safety Committee. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Fiscal Year 2011/12 Second Quarter Financial Report (CC)
1.
Receive the FY 2011/12 Second Quarter Financial Report.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the Operating Program and Capital Improvement Program Budgets for FY 2011/12.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the City-Wide Classification and Compensation Index and repealing all resolutions in conflict herewith.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
